items.name: Jieyang Good Afternoon 2021

venue.name: Vienna International Hotel (Jieyang Jieyanglou)
venue.address: South of East Xinyang Road, West of Lianhua Avenue, Rongcheng District, 522000

items.information: The structure of the competition in Guangzhou this year has been modified due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Competitors are only allowed to compete in one of the two competitions, **[Jieyang Good Morning 2021](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Jieyang-Good-Morning-2021)** and **[Jieyang Good Afternoon 2021](https://cubingchina.com/competition/Jieyang-Good-Afternoon-2021)**, in two half-days respectively.
